decisions.reason: As a large established firm we can tolerate some uncertainty in this niche marine product, and two years of continued listing suggest results are not clearly below aspiration even if demand is narrow.

The dedicated page and the 2019 LED replacement kit indicate follow-on investment and an installed base, which in behavioral terms suggests performance at or above aspiration for this industrial niche.
Because this was a relaunch of a previously popular designer task light and remained actively presented, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough to justify retention.

This newer office pendant appears more exposed to overlap and uncertain office demand, so if its results are below aspiration we would reallocate resources to stronger established lines or new development.
Although still relatively new and somewhat uncertain, its premium positioning gives it differentiation and margin potential, and our organizational slack supports keeping it for another year.
